title: Power of two
description:
A power of two (1, 2, 4, 8, 16 ...) has exactly one bit switched on. Subtracting 1 from it flips that bit off and every lower bit on, so the two numbers share no bits:

```
 8      = 1000
 8 - 1  = 0111
 8 & 7  = 0000
```

Write `bool isPowerOfTwo(unsigned int n)` using that trick. Zero is not a power of two.
hints: Two conditions joined with `&&`: `n` is not zero, and `n & (n - 1)` is zero. Put brackets around the `&` part: `==` binds more tightly than `&`.
